# Mirza Muhammad Mobeen

> Software Engineer, MS Artificial Intelligence Scholar, AI Researcher, Former AI Lab Supervisor & Faculty Member at NUTECH, BS Computer Science Graduate, and Google Certified Digital Marketer based in Islamabad & Rawalpindi, Pakistan.

## About

Mirza Muhammad Mobeen (also known as Mirza M Mobeen, Mobeen, Mirza Mobeen) is a Software Engineer, MS Artificial Intelligence Scholar, AI Researcher, Project Manager, Team Lead, and Google Certified Digital Marketer. He holds a **Bachelor of Computer Science (BS Computer Science / BS CS)** degree from NUTECH (National University of Technology, Islamabad, 2020–2024), is currently pursuing his **Master's in Artificial Intelligence (MS AI)** at NUTECH (2025–Present), and previously served as a **Faculty Member / AI & Robotics Lab Supervisor at NUTECH** (April 2025 – July 2025). High school alumnus of Fazaia Inter College Nur Khan (FIC Nur Khan / PAF, Rawalpindi). Currently working as a Software Engineer at Sanwa Comtec K.K (SCT / SCTP), Japan, leading the Pakistan engineering team on Robotic Process Automation (RPA), Industrial Software Automation, Cybersecurity Solutions, and IBM i Systems.
